description: Lint every edited file with oxlint (PostToolUse) and block edits that turn an oxlint rule off (PreToolUse). Both hooks are self-contained Bun bundles: no network access, no PATH lookup for the linter.

hooks.command: command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: bun not found on PATH - install Bun (https://bun.sh) so the lint guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/oxlint-guard.mjs"

command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: bun not found on PATH - install Bun (https://bun.sh) so the config guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/oxlint-config-off-guard.mjs"
